profile: 4D Molecular Therapeutics develops genetic medicines using its proprietary adeno-associated virus vector discovery and engineering platform. Its lead candidate, 4D-150, is in Phase 3 trials for wet age-related macular degeneration and diabetic macular edema. The company is also developing 4D-710, an inhaled gene therapy candidate for cystic fibrosis, and 4D-175, an investigational program for geographic atrophy.
